create_GazePolicy: create a GazePolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for arm gaze control
create_NavPolicy: create a NavPolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for robot navigation
create_PlacePolicy: create a PlacePolicy instance from a checkpoint path and device for object placement
create_MixerPolicy: create a MixerPolicy that combines nav, gaze, and place expert policies into one
run_RealPolicy_act: run the act method on a RealPolicy to get actions from observations
